segments.title: How many time zones does CHINA use?
segments.say: How many time zones does China use? One, three, or five? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Just ONE!
segments.say: Just one! The whole country runs on Beijing Time.

segments.title: About as wide as the USA
segments.say: China is about as wide as the USA. It spans five geographic time zones.

segments.title: But the clocks ALL match
segments.say: But the official clocks all match.

segments.title: Far west? Sunrise can be LATE
segments.say: So in the far west, the sun can rise late.

segments.title: Some use their own time
segments.say: Some people there also use local Xinjiang time, two hours behind.

segments.sub: for quiz night. Did you guess 5?
segments.say: Did you guess five? Save this for quiz night.
